messages.text: Atlas imports the same conversations twice. Fix the duplication.
In importer.py, use a session fingerprint cache so unchanged conversations are skipped.
Choose the fingerprint cache. Next, test idempotency.

messages.text: We could use a global shared cache.
Reject the global shared cache; choose one cache per project to prevent cross-project contamination.
